verse_of_the_day.text: In all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine trying to walk through a thick, spooky jungle without a map. You would get lost in circles! God is like the ultimate jungle guide with a glowing machete. When we let Him lead the way, He chops down the confusing vines and makes a totally straight, safe path for us to walk on.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, You are the best guide ever. Sometimes I don't know which way to go, but I know You do. Please make my path straight today and show me the right choices to make. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Walk in a perfectly straight line by placing one foot right in front of the other. As you walk, say, 'God is leading me on a straight path!'

verse_of_the_day.text: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever played a video game where your character has a glowing energy shield? God gives you the 'Shield of Faith'! When bad thoughts, fears, or mean words come flying at you like flaming arrows, your super-shield blocks them completely and poofs them out like magic!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for my awesome Shield of Faith. When scary or mean thoughts try to hit my mind today, help me to hold up my shield and block them all! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend you are holding a giant, heavy shield on your arm today. If you start to feel scared or sad, lift your arm up and shout, 'Shield activated!'

verse_of_the_day.text: In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: You are a human glow-stick! When you snap a glow-stick, the stuff inside mixes and makes a super bright color. When you let God's love mix into your heart, you shine brightly! Every time you help someone or share your toys, it is like waving a bright light that makes everyone look up and smile at God.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, make me a super bright glow-stick today! Help me to do kind things so that everyone around me can see Your amazing love shining right out of me. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Do a 'glow-stick deed' today! Help a parent or a friend with a chore before they even ask you, and watch how much it brightens their day.

verse_of_the_day.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Sometimes the dark can feel a little creepy. But guess what? God is like a giant, invisible security guard standing right outside your bedroom door! Because He is awake all night watching over you, you can snuggle deep under your blankets and sleep as peacefully as a totally safe little baby.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, thank You for being my strong security guard. When it is time for bed tonight, help me to feel completely safe knowing You are awake and watching over my room. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: When you get into bed tonight, imagine an incredibly strong, friendly angel standing right by your door to keep you safe while you dream.

verse_of_the_day.text: There is no one holy like the Lord; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Think of the biggest, heaviest, most unbreakable boulder in the entire world. If a hurricane blew past it, the boulder wouldn't even wiggle! God is exactly like that giant rock. While everything else in the world might shake or change, God never moves. You can always lean on Him when you need to feel steady.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, You are the biggest and strongest Rock ever. Thank You that You never shake or change. Help me to lean on You today when I feel wobbly or nervous. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Stand perfectly still like a giant boulder for 30 seconds. Do not let anything make you wiggle or laugh! Remember that God is even stronger than that.

verse_of_the_day.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine giant, beautiful presents with huge shiny bows floating right out of the clouds and landing in your hands! God loves to give us amazing gifts. Everything good in your life—your favorite food, your family, your laugh, and sunny days—are all special presents sent straight from God in heaven.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for all the amazing presents You send me every day. Thank You for my family, my toys, and my friends. Help me to be so thankful for everything You give me. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend you are unwrapping a giant invisible present! As you open it, shout out one of your favorite things in the world and say, 'Thank You, God!'

verse_of_the_day.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever tried to fill a cup with water, but you forgot to turn off the faucet? The water splashes out and goes everywhere! God wants to do that with your heart. He wants to pour so much happy joy and peace into you that it actually overflows and splashes right onto everyone you meet!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Holy Spirit, please fill my heart up right to the top! Pour so much joy and peace into me today that I overflow and splash happiness onto all my friends. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: When you pour a glass of water or juice today, watch it fill up closely. Remember that God wants to fill you up with good things until you overflow!

verse_of_the_day.text: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: The sky is like a gigantic, million-mile-wide movie screen showing off God’s best artwork! Every time you see a bright orange sunset, fluffy clouds, or millions of twinkling stars, the sky is shouting to the whole world, 'Look how amazing and powerful our Creator is!'

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, Your artwork is amazing. Every time I look up at the clouds or the stars, remind me of how big and powerful You are. Thank You for making such a beautiful world! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Go outside today and find your favorite cloud. Tell God why you think it is cool, and thank Him for being such an awesome artist!

verse_of_the_day.text: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Saying 'I love you' is super nice, but DOING 'I love you' is way cooler! Action-love means sharing your last piece of candy, helping your sibling clean up their mess, or giving a big hug when someone is sad. God wants us to prove our love by putting on our boots and getting to work!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, help my hands and feet to show love today. I don't want to just say kind words; I want to do kind actions! Show me who I can help right now. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Find one way to show 'action-love' today. Without saying a word, do a chore or help someone in your house as a secret surprise!

verse_of_the_day.text: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Holding onto anger is like dragging a heavy bag of smelly garbage around with you everywhere you go! It just makes you tired and grumpy. Forgiving someone is how you drop the garbage bag into the trash can. God forgave all of our mistakes, so we can drop the heavy garbage and forgive others too!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, holding onto anger makes my heart feel heavy like a garbage bag. Please help me to forgive the people who upset me, just like You always forgive me. Give me a light and happy heart today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: If you are feeling mad at someone today, imagine yourself throwing a heavy, smelly garbage bag right into the trash. Say out loud, 'I drop this anger and I forgive them!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever played a game on a tablet and the battery completely died? You have to plug it in and patiently wait for it to charge back up! When we go through hard days, we can feel totally drained. But praying is like plugging your heart right into God's super-charger. He fills you back up with bright, joyful hope!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, sometimes my energy feels completely empty. Help me to remember to plug into Your power by praying to You. Fill me up with Your super-charged joy and patience today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: When you see a phone or tablet plugged into a charger today, take a deep breath and say a quick prayer to let God recharge your heart!

verse_of_the_day.text: One who has unreliable friends soon comes to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Think of the strongest, stickiest superglue in the entire world. Once it sticks, you cannot pull it apart! Some friends might leave when things get hard, but Jesus is your superglue friend. He promises to stick by your side through the fun times, the sad times, and the scary times. He will never un-stick from you!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for being my superglue friend. Thank You that You never leave me, no matter what happens. Help me to be a loyal and sticky friend to others, too. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Stick two pieces of tape together as tightly as you can today. Try to pull them apart, and let it remind you of how tightly Jesus holds onto you!

verse_of_the_day.text: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Your words can be a heavy, smashing wrecking ball, or they can be a team of master builders with hard hats! When we say mean things, we knock people down. But when we encourage people and say kind things, we build them up taller and stronger, like an awesome skyscraper!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, put a hard hat on my head today! Help me to be a master builder instead of a wrecking ball. Give me kind words that make my friends and family feel tall and strong. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Find one person today and 'build them up' by giving them a really awesome compliment. Tell them they are smart, funny, or great at a game!

verse_of_the_day.text: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine trying to walk across a wobbly tightrope high up in the air. That would be terrifying! But what if a massive, totally safe giant hand was holding you up the entire time so you couldn't fall? That is what God does for you! He holds you up with His strong, powerful hand every single day so you never have to be afraid.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, sometimes life feels wobbly and scary. Thank You for holding me up with Your giant, powerful hand. Keep me safe and strong so I do not have to be afraid. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Hold onto an adult's hand today when you walk somewhere. Notice how safe it makes you feel, and remember that God's invisible hand is holding you too!

verse_of_the_day.text: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: This verse is like a secret cheat code that reverses gravity! Normally, when someone is mean to us, we want to be mean right back. But Jesus tells us to do the exact opposite. We are supposed to throw a 'kindness boomerang'! When we pray for people who are mean, it shocks them with love and makes our own hearts super strong.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, it is really hard to be nice to people who are mean to me. Please give me the superpower to throw a kindness boomerang! Help me to pray for them and show them Your amazing love. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Think of someone who was not very nice to you recently. Right now, say a tiny 10-second prayer asking God to give them a really happy day.

verse_of_the_day.text: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever had to walk through a dark, spooky room and felt your heart beat really fast? Walking with Jesus is like having the bravest hero walking right beside you with a massive, glowing torch! Even in the darkest, scariest valleys of life, His light keeps the monsters away and keeps you totally safe.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, You are my brave hero with the glowing torch. Whenever I have to walk through a scary or dark time, remind me that You are right there with me to fight off my fears. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Make a tunnel out of blankets today. Crawl through it with a flashlight and pretend you are walking through a dark valley, completely safe with God's light!

verse_of_the_day.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Real love is not just a fluffy red heart on a valentine card. Real love is a superhero cape made out of patience and kindness! It means waiting your turn without whining, not bragging when you win a game, and cheering for your friends when they get something cool instead of being jealous.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, wrap me up in Your superhero cape of love today! Help me to be patient when I have to wait, kind when I want to be grumpy, and happy for my friends when they do well. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Practice your 'superhero patience' today. The next time you have to wait in line or wait for a turn to play, take a deep breath and smile without complaining!

verse_of_the_day.text: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God owns the biggest, most endless treasure chest in the whole universe! He has infinite peace, joy, strength, and love. When you run out of energy or feel like you do not have what you need, God opens up His giant, glowing treasure chest and hands you exactly what you need at the perfect time.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for having an endless treasure chest. Whenever I need more strength, peace, or help today, please reach into Your treasure chest and give me exactly what I need. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a huge, wooden treasure chest on a piece of paper. Instead of gold coins, draw what you need from God today—like a heart for love, or a lightning bolt for energy!

verse_of_the_day.text: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: It is super fun to make plans, like drawing a map with crayons for an awesome adventure! But sometimes, our plans get messed up. It is okay, because God is the ultimate airplane pilot. Even if our crayon map changes, God is flying the plane, and He knows exactly how to get us safely to the best destination!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, I like to make my own plans, but I know You are the best pilot! When my plans change and I feel disappointed, help me to trust that You are steering me in the perfect direction. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Fold a paper airplane today and fly it across the room. As it flies, say: 'God is the pilot of my life, and He knows where I am going!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever planted a tiny seed in the dirt? You water it for days, and nothing happens. It can be boring! But if you don't quit, suddenly a tiny green shoot pops up, and one day it becomes a giant, juicy watermelon! Doing good things is like planting seeds. Keep being kind, and don't give up. A giant harvest of good things is coming!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, sometimes I get tired of doing the right thing, especially when no one notices. Help me to keep planting my good seeds of kindness and love. Give me the strength to never give up! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Eat a piece of fruit with seeds in it today (like an apple, watermelon, or orange). Look at the tiny seed and remind yourself that doing good always grows into something big!

verse_of_the_day.text: But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine being the captain of a giant spaceship! You get to choose which planet to fly to. Every day, God gives you the steering wheel and lets you choose who you will follow. Choosing to serve God is like steering your spaceship toward the brightest, most exciting star in the galaxy!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, I want to be a great captain today. I choose to steer my life toward You. Help me and my whole family to serve You with happy hearts! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend to steer a giant steering wheel today. Whenever you have to make a choice, steer your wheel toward the 'God' direction!

verse_of_the_day.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever drawn a picture and made a big mistake with a dark marker? You can't just wipe it off. But God has a giant, super-powered magic eraser! When we tell Him we are sorry for doing something wrong, He totally erases it from our hearts so we are perfectly clean and brand new again.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for Your magic eraser. When I mess up and make mistakes, please forgive me and wipe my heart perfectly clean. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a scribble on a piece of paper with a pencil, and then use an eraser to rub it away completely. Remember that God does that to our mistakes!

verse_of_the_day.text: Search me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: When you go to the airport, your bags have to go through a cool X-ray machine to make sure there is nothing dangerous inside. God has X-ray vision for our hearts! He can look deep inside and see if there are any scary worries or bad attitudes hiding in there so He can help us clean them out.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, please use Your X-ray vision on my heart today. If there are any hidden worries or bad attitudes, help me to spot them and give them to You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Make binoculars with your hands and look around your room. Ask God to help you see any bad habits you need to clean up!

verse_of_the_day.text: Jesus said, 'Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.'

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine trying to get into a super exclusive, awesome theme park, but the guards say you are too small. Jesus is the owner of the park, and He runs over, opens the gates wide, and gives you a glowing VIP pass! He says kids are actually the most important guests in His entire Kingdom.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You that I am so important to You. Thank You for giving me a VIP pass to Your heart. I am so glad You love kids! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Make yourself a VIP badge out of paper and tape it to your shirt today. Let it remind you that you are a Very Important Person to Jesus!

verse_of_the_day.text: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Laughter is like a fizzy, bubbling, magic potion! When you are feeling sad or sick, laughing and having a joyful heart actually sends healing medicine all through your body. God created giggles and smiles to make us feel strong and healthy.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, thank You for inventing laughter! When I feel sad or grumpy, please give me a cheerful heart. Help me to drink Your fizzy medicine of joy today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Try to make someone in your house laugh today by telling them a funny joke or making a silly face!

verse_of_the_day.text: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Think about a fuzzy, crawling caterpillar wrapping itself up in a cocoon. When it comes out, it isn't a caterpillar anymore—it is a totally new, flying butterfly with colorful wings! When we invite Jesus into our hearts, He does the exact same thing to us. He gives us brand new, beautiful wings to fly!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for making me a brand new creation. Help me to leave my old, grumpy caterpillar habits behind and fly like a beautiful butterfly today! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend you are a butterfly today! Flap your arms like colorful wings and remember that God made your heart brand new.

verse_of_the_day.text: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever tasted plain flour or raw eggs? Yuck! But when a Master Baker mixes those gross ingredients together and puts them in the oven, they turn into a delicious, sweet cake. Sometimes life has hard or sad parts, but God is mixing them all together to bake something beautiful for your future.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, sometimes things happen that I don't like. But I know You are the Master Baker. Thank You for mixing everything together to make my life good and sweet. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: The next time you eat a yummy treat, remember that God can take hard things and turn them into something amazing!

verse_of_the_day.text: The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Every morning when you wake up, God hands you a giant, totally blank white canvas and a brand new box of bright paints! He made this specific day just for you, and He wants you to paint it with joy, laughter, and gladness. There has never been a day exactly like today in the history of the world!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for this brand new day. Thank You for giving me a blank canvas. Help me to paint today with super bright colors of joy and gladness! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a big, smiling sun on a piece of paper today and hang it on your wall to remind you to be glad for this brand new day.

verse_of_the_day.text: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever squeezed a tube of toothpaste way too hard? The paste goes everywhere, and you can never push it back inside the tube! Words are exactly like toothpaste. Once they come out of your mouth, you can't put them back. God wants us to be super careful to only squeeze out kind, helpful words.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, help me to guard my mouth today. Remind me that my words are like toothpaste! Help me to only speak kind things that build my friends up. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: When you brush your teeth tonight, look at the toothpaste and promise God that you will be careful with the words you squeeze out of your mouth tomorrow.

verse_of_the_day.text: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: This verse is your ultimate Superhero Mission Checklist from God! Number one: Act justly (always play fair). Number two: Love mercy (give people second chances). Number three: Walk humbly (don't brag or act like you are better than anyone else). If you complete these three missions, you are a true hero!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for giving me a clear superhero mission. Help me to play fair, give second chances, and walk humbly right beside You all day long. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Write the numbers 1, 2, and 3 on your hand today. Let them remind you of your three daily missions: Fair, Forgive, and Humble!

verse_of_the_day.text: Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine you are having a normal day, and suddenly the King of the Universe knocks on your front door with a box of hot pizza, asking to hang out with you! Jesus is knocking on the door of your heart every single day. He doesn't want to just be a rule-maker; He wants to be your best friend who comes inside to share a meal and hang out!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, I hear You knocking! I open the door of my heart right now and invite You to come inside. Thank You for wanting to be my best friend. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Go to the front door of your house, open it wide, and whisper, 'Come on in, Jesus! You are always welcome in my heart.'
